column1: # The looks of Lumen Home (model/Looks): one row per look, no code. Picking one in Customize Home writes these values
# into the user's layout; changing one of them afterwards makes it his own. The name of a look is the string
# home_look_<id> (res/values*/strings_layout.xml), so a new row needs that string in every language first.
# Columns: id, hero (full | small | none), big clock (the calm screen, or in place of the hero where it fits), Continue
# id      hero   clock  continue  showcase  rows
